title: Getaway! Walk to Coffee and Food -2 Car Garage!
description:
Welcome to your luxury retreat in Berry Hill! This spacious 4-bedroom home, each with a private bathroom, offers comfort and style. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area is perfect for gatherings. Relax on the rooftop patio or enjoy fun nights with the karaoke machine. Located just 10 minutes from downtown and 3 minutes from Geodis Park, you’re close to Nashville’s top attractions. With a two-car garage, convenience is guaranteed. Book now for an unforgettable stay!

The space
4 bedrooms each with a private bathroom. Rooftop patio with games and lounge furniture! Double car garage. Open concept living/dining/kitchen. Perfect for your crew's Nashville stay! Did I mention there's a karaoke machine?

Guest access
You'll have the entire home to yourself.
